review.purpose: Original HR04 C003 Food root. Retain the full post and complete ASv6.100 root tree; historical definitions and relationship labels are evidence, not semantic gold.

accepted_historical_witness.fixed_meaning: Food is substances intended for human consumption as nourishment or as components of something eaten or drunk, including but not limited to prepared dishes and ingredients used to make or season them.
accepted_historical_witness.counterexample: A lethal, non-edible chemical deliberately intended to be consumed by a human as a component of a poisoned drink.

user_judgment.quote: while i hate to say it, i think the couterexample is doing it's job. the explicit meaning must be air-tight. and i don't think this one was
user_judgment.accepted: This exact old meaning admits the poisoned-drink component through its stated component alternative; the witness exposes insufficient closure of that meaning.
user_judgment.limits: The full C003/C004 relationship, ceremonial-gold witness, other Food definitions and fresh producer outputs are not approved by this judgment. No particular replacement boundary is prescribed.
